idea-plugin.name: VHDL Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
VHDL support for CLion, powered by the open-source VHDL-LS language server.

  • Syntax highlighting for .vhd / .vhdl (VHDL-2008 lexing)
  • Semantic colouring: types, design units, libraries, packages, subprogram calls, labels, declared objects and attributes each get their own colour, customizable under Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | VHDL
  • Live diagnostics, go to definition, find references, completion, hover and rename via VHDL-LS
  • Comment/uncomment with --, parenthesis matching
  • VHDL-LS binary bundled for Linux and Windows x86_64; other platforms use vhdl_ls from PATH

For whole-project analysis, put a vhdl_ls.toml in the project root mapping your libraries; without it, open files are analyzed standalone.

Roadmap: smart end completion, Vivado (.xpr) project recognition.
